ccfc.cc_fact_check_notes: This ISC fabrication covers a generic wildfire emergency and mass displacement scenario. 4 claims supported: 50,000 displaced and 2,500 structures destroyed (consistent with documented major California wildfire impacts, e.g., 2018 Camp Fire displaced 50,000+); $500M FEMA disaster relief (consistent with documented FEMA DRF funding); climate change exacerbating wildfire frequency/intensity (NOAA/IPCC confirmed scientific consensus); infrastructure loss complicating rescue operations (CPUC/CAL FIRE documented). 1 insufficient: 35% area inaccessibility (general principle confirmed but specific percentage unverifiable for unnamed fictional event). 1 refuted: '2 million acres' in a single wildfire (California 2023 total season was ~57,000 acres; largest single California fire on record is the 2021 Dixie Fire at 963,309 acres; 2 million in one event has no documented precedent).
